title: LMSYS-CHAT-1M: A LARGE-SCALE REAL-WORLD LLM CONVERSATION DATASET
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech based on religion as a sub-category within a broader content moderation framework.
findings: The dataset contains a non-trivial amount of harmful content (5% of conversations flagged), which can be used to train content moderation models. A fine-tuned 7B model (Vicuna-moderator-7B) can match GPT-4's performance on a content moderation task that includes identifying hate speech based on religion.
